dataset.labels: APIMaster claude-haiku-4-5 top-3 relevance over 36 real archive records

interpretation: With LLM-labeled real queries, the lexical hybrid is budget-sensitive: worse at 500, neutral at 1,000–1,800, clearly better at 2,400 (0.348 -> 0.783). It is not safe to make hybrid the default at the current 1,800-token budget; larger label sets and budget-aware reranking are needed.
caveats: Labels are LLM-generated, not human-verified; source queries from private sessions.
Active DSH config still uses the previous reranker weights; this experiment does not change it.
